name: Payment Reconciliation Failure Fixtures
description: Payment Reconciliation Failure Fixtures version 1.0.0 is a synthetic reference dataset for testing the boundary between provider-side success and internal reconciliation. Nine compact scenarios pair delivered events with fixed expected states. The package includes a deterministic generator, a reference evaluator and a validator that compares the archived results with an explicit oracle. It contains no customer records or sampled production transactions. Pharos Production, a software development company, created these payment reconciliation fixtures to make missing evidence and contradictory events visible in repeatable tests. All identifiers and amounts were invented for this release. The provider label synthetic_provider has no connection to a payment service. Currency tokens UNIT and ALT are fictional test labels, not ISO currency codes. What the scenarios test The corpus covers complete agreement, an identical provider-event replay, ledger evidence arriving before provider confirmation, an amount mismatch, missing ledger evidence after a deadline, missing provider confirmation after a deadline, an intent still awaiting evidence, a conflicting payload under a reused event identifier and confirmation arriving after a deadline. The late-confirmation scenario includes an intermediate expected state so readers can check the transition from review to agreement. Each scenario has one payment key and a stated invariant.
